description: List every rule in a federal court rules set with its number and title: FRCP (civil procedure), FRE (evidence), FRAP (appellate), FRCrP (criminal procedure) or FRBP (bankruptcy). Also returns the "as amended to" date the publisher states for the set. Use to find the rule number before get_federal_rule.

set.description: Rule set: frcp (Civil Procedure), fre (Evidence), frap (Appellate), frcrp (Criminal Procedure), frbp (Bankruptcy). Aliases such as frcrmp and "civil" are accepted.

name: list_federal_rules
